issues.quote: revenue rising 29.7% to $281.7 billion from $245.1 billion
issues.problem: Growing from $245.1B to $281.7B is about 14.9%, not 29.7%. The wrong figure also contradicts the claim that net income (+15.5%) grew slightly faster than revenue.

data.summary: The figures match Microsoft's reported FY2025 and FY2024 results, but the revenue growth rate is wrong: it should be about 14.9%, not 29.7%.
